# About This Volume {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This is **Volume 3 of 3** of *Biostatistics Practicum*, the
industry-practice supplement. The book is also published whole, as
a single continuously numbered site, at
<https://practicum.rgtlab.org>; the print edition is split into
three volumes only because one bound book would exceed a comfortable
page count.

**This volume** covers Parts V and VI: statistical analysis plans,
testing and continuous integration, and the pharmaceutical industry
chapters (clinical data standards and SAS). It is built on Parts I
to III and is the recommended addition for pharmaceutical-track
students, alongside the one-quarter core path described in the
preface.

**Volume 1**, *Why, Toolkit, and Data*, covers why reproducible
research matters, team science, de-identification, the toolkit, and
working with data. It comes before this volume and is assumed
throughout.

**Volume 2**, *Documents, Environments, and Case Studies*, covers
documents and environments, the two worked case studies, and the
capstone. It also carries the book's full reference apparatus: the
glossary, cheat sheets, the instructor guide, and the rest of the
appendices. If you need any of those while reading this volume, they
are in Volume 2.

Cross-references within this volume work as usual. A reference to
material in another volume is written as plain text, for example
'Chapter 20 (renv for Package Management) in Volume 2', since a
printed volume cannot link into a book it is not bound with.
